summary: Three shortlisted industries where paperwork blocks money: construction (contractors, developers and their lenders), freight trucking (small fleet owners and transporters) and MSME engineering suppliers. All run on WhatsApp, Excel and paper, and all already pay for some software.
buyer: Owner or finance head at the business; technical or credit head at lenders
user: Site and billing engineers, transport billing staff, costing and quality engineers
geography: India; pilots in Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat and Uttar Pradesh
stage: Early adopters pay for basic apps (site, GPS, accounting); the AI layer is largely absent

segments.name: Housing finance lenders
segments.description: Release construction-linked tranches after site inspections.

segments.name: Government-works contractors
segments.size_hint: Illustrative: tens of thousands registered on CPPP/GeM

segments.name: Small fleet owners and transporters
segments.size_hint: Illustrative: most trucks are owned by small fleets
segments.description: Invoice shippers after paper proof of delivery; wait weeks for payment.

segments.name: Tier-2/3 engineering and auto-component suppliers
segments.size_hint: Illustrative: lakhs of manufacturing MSMEs on Udyam
segments.description: Answer RFQs by hand and assemble OEM quality documents.
